VGP.Title: Inventory
VGP.Configure: Scenery and settings for this shop
VGP.Overflow: {count} item(s) do not fit in the grid
VGP.Warn.NoItemPiles: Velvet Grid Piles requires the Item Piles module to be active.
VGP.Warn.NoPermission: You do not have permission to rearrange this inventory.
VGP.Warn.NoCharacter: Pick a character to receive the items first.
VGP.Warn.PurchaseOnly: This merchant does not buy anything.
VGP.Warn.NotForSale: That item is not for sale.
VGP.Warn.NoInspect: This container does not allow inspecting its items.
VGP.Warn.NoOwnedActors: You own no actor that could receive the items.
VGP.Info.NativeNext: Next time this pile will open with the standard Item Piles interface.
VGP.Config.Strict: Real capacity (if it does not fit, it stays out)
VGP.Settings.gridForContainers.Name: Grid for containers
VGP.Settings.gridForContainers.Hint: Item Piles containers open as a grid instead of a list.
VGP.Settings.gridForMerchants.Name: Grid for merchants
VGP.Settings.gridForMerchants.Hint: Shops open as a grid, with the price drawn on each item.
VGP.Settings.gridForPiles.Name: Grid for loose piles
VGP.Settings.gridForPiles.Hint: Loot piles on the ground open as a grid.
VGP.Settings.strictByDefault.Name: Real capacity by default
VGP.Settings.strictByDefault.Hint: When on, an item that finds no free space cannot be put in. When off the grid grows downwards and never refuses anything. Can be overridden per pile.
VGP.Settings.bulkyItems.Name: Derive size from weight
VGP.Settings.bulkyItems.Hint: Items that declare no size derive it from their weight (5e) or bulk (PF2e). When off, everything is one cell unless it carries its own size.
VGP.Settings.cellSize.Name: Cell size (px)
VGP.Settings.pileCols.Name: Default columns (container)
VGP.Settings.pileCols.Hint: Starting width of container and merchant grids.
VGP.Settings.pileRows.Name: Default rows (container)
VGP.Settings.pileRows.Hint: Minimum height of container and merchant grids.
VGP.Settings.actorCols.Name: Default columns (character)
VGP.Settings.actorCols.Hint: Width of the character panel grid.
VGP.Settings.actorRows.Name: Default rows (character)
VGP.Settings.actorRows.Hint: Minimum height of the character panel grid.
VGP.Sort.Name: Sort by: Name
VGP.Settings.showLabels.Name: Name and price on every cell
VGP.Settings.showLabels.Hint: Draws the item name and price under its icon, like a shop window. When off, only the icon shows and the price floats in a corner.
VGP.Settings.backgroundImage.Name: Window background image
VGP.Settings.backgroundImage.Hint: Art drawn behind both panels, so the shop reads as a counter rather than a list. Ships with a bundled background you can swap for your own; leave empty for the plain dark theme.
VGP.Config.SceneryNote: The scenery belongs to this pile: every shop can have its own. Leave empty to use the world background.
VGP.Settings.portraitSize.Name: Portrait height (px)
VGP.Settings.portraitSize.Hint: How large the merchant and character figures are in the header. Drawn frameless with faded edges so they blend into the background.
VGP.Detail.Title: Item
VGP.Warn.AbsolutePath: The image "{path}" lives outside Foundry's data folder, so the browser cannot load it. Copy it into Foundry_Data/Data (a folder of your own, or worlds/your-world) and pick it with the browse button.
VGP.Config.SoundNote: Only whoever opens the shop hears these, not the rest of the table.
VGP.Settings.soundVolume.Name: Shop volume
VGP.Settings.soundVolume.Hint: Volume for the welcome, farewell, buy and sell sounds. Zero mutes them. Client-only, and multiplied by Foundry's interface volume.
VGP.Config.IdentityNote: Leave empty to use the actor name and the pile type.
VGP.Warn.NoTakeAllMerchant: You cannot empty a merchant in one go: items have to be bought.
